- The whole leasable space including the newly constructed 40,770 Sq.ft building is let to a small number of reputed corporate lessees - the additional building was leased to a single existing lessee - so rental income depends on lease renewal by few counterparties (Directors' Report Outlook, cross-bundle from the profile bundle)
- MD&A notes an increasing occupier preference for Grade A, ESG-compliant warehouses with modern storage solutions and that occupiers now expect standard specifications inside the base rent rather than as value-added charges, which raises the specification bar and overall occupancy cost the landlord must meet
- Engineering Services revenue depends on demand from domestic and overseas textile machinery manufacturers and machine tool makers, so it is exposed to that customer capex/replacement cycle (MD&A Industry Structure and Opportunities sections)
- The segment caters to overseas as well as domestic customers, giving exposure to export demand and cross-border trading conditions (MD&A, Opportunities and Threats - B)
- Future growth is stated to depend on new warehouse construction in vacant spaces executed in stages and aligned to market requirements, with no committed timeline or quantum disclosed, so growth is contingent on demand materialising (Directors' Report Outlook)
- The auditors certify that, with paid-up equity capital of Rs 6.69 crores and net worth of Rs 21.75 crores as on 31.03.2025, Regulations 17 to 27 and related governance provisions of the Listing Regulations do not apply for FY ended March 31, 2026, so the company operates under a lighter governance-disclosure regime (Annexure 4, Auditors' Certificate on Corporate Governance)

strategy.body:
- Phased, demand-led warehouse expansion: new warehouse construction to be executed in the vacant spaces at Hosur in stages, aligned precisely with market requirements
- Identify new supply areas for the Engineering Services segment to generate order inflow
- Pursue re-engineering initiatives and expand supplies to new customers in Engineering Services to improve turnover and profitability
- Explore opportunities in other business segments beyond the two existing segments
